Muslim friendly breakfast buffet
Aug 2024 • Friends
The restaurant looks quite luxurious. The breakfast buffet were delicious. For Muslims, you can have their half-boiled eggs, omelette (upon request), salad, gluttonous rice with mango, seaweed, vegetarian sandwich, pancakes (really good), pastries, lotus cake, plenty choices of fruits, yoghurt and you can also enjoy their Vietnamese latte every day (upon request). Their staffs were very kind and helpful too. Everyone did a very good job in assuring me and my friends that as Muslims, we can eat some of their menu.
